name: s_ablation_mstca_v1
purpose: Source-domain structural ablation of the MSTCA baseline: is SE needed, is multi-scale needed, does MSTCA beat a parameter-matched plain CNN1D. KG branch is out of scope (abandoned by decision, not by this experiment).

S3.question: Does MSTCA beat a parameter-matched plain CNN1D?

initialization.factory: packages/uav_fault/uav_fault/models/cnn/ablation_factory.py: build_variant(variant, 26, 2, 0.2) then initialize_variant(model, variant, seed, policy='module_seed_v1')
initialization.historical_anchor: Not used. S0 is a new-policy M0, not the historical seed42 M0.
initialization.receipt: Save the factory receipt (full_state_digest, shared_subset_digest, key lists) in every run directory and assert full_state_digest equals the golden value in tests/test_mstca_ablation_factory.py for that (variant, seed).

data.root: causal_input_v1 (same data_identities SHA256 as configs/experiments/causal_pure_mstca_m0_v1.json; verify all nine before any run)
data.population: source train qualified windows only (ledgers/train_included_windows.csv, 162069 windows). association_group must be read as string (dtype=str) to keep leading zeros.

outer_folds.note: Same folds as feature_groupcv_v1 / ens_groupcv_seed43_v1, so S-arm held-out predictions can later be paired with existing GBT held-out predictions.

inner_selection.rule: inner = int(sha256('s_ablation_inner_v1|' + association_group).hexdigest(), 16) % 10 == 0, applied inside the two training folds
inner_selection.use: Inner windows never receive gradients; they are used only for checkpoint selection and early stopping.

training.recipe: Identical to the frozen M0 B recipe (causal_pure_mstca_m0_v1 'balanced_source_normal' arm) except fit population, initialization and selection.
training.sampler: WeightedRandomSampler, replacement=True, balanced_source_normal weights recomputed on the fit population with the existing source.sampling_weights(labels, normal_origin, True); draws per epoch = number of fit windows; sampler generator seed+11, loader generator seed+101; num_workers 0
training.optimizer: AdamW lr 3e-4, weight_decay 1e-4, batch 512, gradient clip 1.0 (error_if_nonfinite)
training.schedule: existing get_warmup_cosine_lr, warmup 5, horizon 100 epochs, min_lr 1e-6
training.determinism: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True); cudnn.benchmark False; cudnn.deterministic True; cudnn.allow_tf32 True; matmul.allow_tf32 False; CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 asserted (not setdefault); np/torch/cuda seeds = seed
training.model_rng: Model construction and initialization only via the factory; global RNG must be unchanged by it.

selection.metric: class-balanced cross-entropy on inner windows: 0.5*mean(-log p_y | y=0) + 0.5*mean(-log p_y | y=1), from softmax of eval-mode logits, float64 accumulation; lower is better
selection.checkpoint: save best on strict decrease; earliest epoch wins exact ties
selection.early_stop: min_epochs 30; stop when 20 consecutive epochs (counted after min_epochs) give no significant improvement, where significant = loss < reference * (1 - 0.005); the reference is updated only on significant improvement
selection.also_save: last-epoch weights and held-out predictions (sensitivity analysis only)
selection.forbidden: Do not evaluate the outer held-out fold during training. Held-out predictions are produced once, after training stops, for best and last weights.

runs.phase1_cv: 4 arms x 3 seeds x 3 outer folds = 36 runs. Each run trains on fit windows of the other two folds and predicts every window of its held-out fold.
runs.order: for seed in [42, 43, 44]: for fold in [0, 1, 2]: for arm in [S0, S1, S2, S3]. A seed is analysable only when all 12 of its runs are COMPLETE.
runs.phase2_val: Only after phase-1 verdicts are written and their file SHA256 recorded: 4 arms x 3 seeds = 12 runs on all train fit windows (all three folds minus inner), same selection on inner, then one prediction pass over all 34710 source val windows.
runs.rerun_policy: A run may be repeated with identical configuration only after an infrastructure failure (OOM, disconnect, node loss); log the failure. Never change seed, arm or settings to replace a completed run.

evaluation.population: phase 1: pooled outer held-out predictions per (arm, seed) = all 162069 train windows, each predicted by the model that did not train on its fold

primary.name: FP@R97
primary.definition: Per (arm, seed): t* = largest fault-probability value t among fault windows such that the fraction of fault windows with p >= t is >= 0.97; FP@R97 = number of normal windows (qualified_y == 0) with p >= t*.
primary.comparison: ratio = FP@R97(arm) / FP@R97(S0), paired by seed; seed aggregate = geometric mean of the three per-seed ratios

secondary: at fixed threshold p_fault > 0.5: all-normal FP, fault TP, late_hover FP (by SIL/HIL), independent non-hover FP, per-class recall outside late_hover, late_hover GPS and barometer recall
per-class fault recall at t* (matched-recall operating point), outside late_hover
class-balanced CE and Brier score on held-out
best epoch, epochs run, wall time, param count, Conv/Linear MAC
last-epoch versions of the primary metric and AP (sensitivity)
sanity only, not a controlled comparison: S0 seed 42/43 at p>0.5 vs historical M0 fold predictions of feature_groupcv_v1 and ens_groupcv_seed43_v1

uncertainty.method: association_group cluster bootstrap, 2000 replicates, rng seed 20261106. In each replicate resample groups with replacement over the pooled held-out population once and apply the same resample to every arm and seed; recompute t* per arm inside the replicate.
uncertainty.report: 95% percentile interval for the seed-aggregate ratio and for each per-seed ratio; same for delta AP

decision_rules.margin: non-inferiority margin 1.10 on the FP@R97 ratio (arm may have at most 10% more false positives than S0)
decision_rules.class_constraint: At t*, no fault class (outside late_hover) may lose more than 1.0 pp recall versus S0 (seed-mean). If violated, verdict is TRADE_OFF regardless of the ratio.
decision_rules.seed_consistency: The per-seed ratio point estimates must fall on the same side of 1 in at least 2 of 3 seeds for any non-INCONCLUSIVE verdict.

S1_S2.COMPONENT_HELPS: lower 95% bound of the seed-aggregate ratio > 1.0

S3.MSTCA_BETTER: lower 95% bound of the S3/S0 ratio > 1.0

decision_rules.AP_consistency: If the AP difference CI points the other way from the FP@R97 verdict (e.g. REMOVABLE but delta AP upper bound < 0), downgrade to INCONCLUSIVE and report both.
decision_rules.late_hover: Reported separately, never a veto (as frozen in m0s_stats_branch_v1).
decision_rules.phase2_confirmation: On source val (same metrics, no bootstrap re-selection): a phase-1 verdict is CONFIRMED if the val point-estimate ratio lies on the same side of 1.0 (for HELPS/BETTER) or below 1.10 (for REMOVABLE/NO_ADVANTAGE); otherwise NOT_CONFIRMED and both results are reported. Val never changes the phase-1 verdict.

preflight_gates: SSH alias autodl_UAV reachable; record GPU model, driver, CUDA
formal environment torch 2.5.1+cu124, numpy 2.1.3, CUDA available; mismatch stops
pytest tests/test_mstca_ablation_factory.py passes on the formal environment, in particular all 12 golden digests. On mismatch: STOP and report; never regenerate goldens.
this protocol file matches its .sha256 lock; code SHA256 match code_identities
nine data_identities SHA256 match; outer fold and inner sizes match the expected numbers
GPU determinism: S0 seed 42 fold 0 for 2 epochs run twice from scratch gives identical state_digest; otherwise STOP and report
CPU smoke (already done locally before server): every arm trains 2 epochs on <= 2048 fit windows, selection and prediction files written

code_identities.new_scripts: scripts/research/train_s_ablation.py and scripts/research/evaluate_s_ablation.py are written after this freeze; their SHA256 are recorded in the run manifest before the first formal run and must not change during phase 1.

outputs: artifacts/s_ablation_mstca_v1/<phase>/<arm>_seed<seed>_fold<fold>/ with report.json, factory_receipt.json, best.pt, last.pt, heldout_predictions_best.npz, heldout_predictions_last.npz (probabilities + original_cache_index). Fresh directories only; refuse to overwrite.
forbidden: internal test or any Real data
Macro-F1 or any val-based checkpoint selection
evaluating the outer held-out fold during training
changing arms, margin, metric, recall level, bootstrap or decision rules after any phase-1 result is seen
dropping or replacing a seed; reporting only the best seed
regenerating golden digests on the formal environment
